about: Pinned parity-scale fixtures for scripts/bench/rss_bench_v2.py (PAR-EVAL-05). Each is fetched at an exact upstream commit into a scratch cache (never vendored into this repository), checked against its commit and tree id, then materialized from git objects into a workspace repo whose tree id, file count and on-disk content SHA-256 are pinned below. Only Apache-2.0 and MIT sources are used (PARITY_REQUIREMENTS §2.4, §12.3).

parity-composite.about: The real multi-language 5-10k-file repository for PAR-EVAL-05: cline, pi-mono and openhands (minus enterprise/) as top-level directories of one repo (TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, Python, C and more).

v1-generated.about: The frozen v1 workload's fixture: 501 files, ~20 MiB of generated Go, Rust and TypeScript (rss_bench.generate_repo, byte-identical across runs). Built locally, no network; used by the CI agents scenarios.

feature_on_rule: A marker is on when it is a scalar other than null, false, 0 or an off word (off, disabled, absent, none, false, no, 0, stopped, inactive, unavailable, error), or an object that has at least one of the fields enabled, state or status, each of them on by the same test. An object without any of those fields, and any list, is off. An off observation is kept over later on ones. Workstreams emitting a marker (WS-13, WS-14, WS-15, WS-37) follow this rule.

watcher.detect: a watcher_state key in a tool result that is on by on_rule, for example "watching" or {"state": "watching"}

static_embeddings.detect: a semantic_lane or embedding_lane key in a search result that is on by on_rule, for example {"state": "on", "kind": "static"}

uncapped_index.requirement: PAR-RT-09, no file cap at parity scale (WS-14)
uncapped_index.detect: search coverage.truncated is false on the fixture

resident_index.requirement: PAR-RT-01, resident index service with snapshot swap (WS-14)
resident_index.detect: an integer snapshot_generation key in search/explain/impact results (coverage or freshness block); the resident service increments it on every snapshot swap
